      '</span></div>'+
      '<div class="win-body" id="finalMediaDeleteBody"><p>⏳ তালিকা লোড হচ্ছে...</p></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(w);
    makeWindowDrag(w);
    return w;
  }

  async function fillDeleteWindow(){
    var w=ensureDeleteWindow(),body=document.getElementById('finalMediaDeleteBody');
    if(!body)return;
    body.innerHTML='<p>⏳ মিডিয়া তালিকা লোড হচ্ছে...</p>';
    try{
      var fresh=await call('listMedia',token);
      if(Array.isArray(fresh))window.media=fresh;
      else if(fresh&&Array.isArray(fresh.media))window.media=fresh.media;
    }catch(e){}
    if(!window.media||!media.length){
      body.innerHTML='<p style="font-weight:900">ডিলেট করার কোনো মিডিয়া নেই।</p>';
      return;
    }
    body.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:900;margin-bottom:8px">প্রতিটি মিডিয়া আলাদা করে ডিলেট করুন:</div>'+
      media.map(function(x,i){
        var name=typeof escapeHtml==='function'?escapeHtml(x.Name||('Media '+(i+1))):String(x.Name||('Media '+(i+1)));
        var typ=escapeHtml?escapeHtml(String(x.Type||'')):'';
        return '<div class="final-media-delete-row"><span><b>'+name+'</b> <small>('+typ+')</small></span>'+
          '<button type="button" class="secondary" onclick="deleteFinalMediaItem('+i+')">🗑️ ডিলেট</button></div>';
      }).join('');
  }

  window.deleteCurrentMedia=window.openFinalMediaDelete;

  window.deleteFinalMediaItem=async function(i){
    if(!window.media||!media[i])return;
    var x=media[i];
    try{
      var r=await call('deleteMedia',token,x.Serial);
      if(r&&r.ok){
        media.splice(i,1);
        if(mediaIndex>=media.length)mediaIndex=Math.max(0,media.length-1);
        if(typeof renderMedia==='function')renderMedia();
        setTimeout(ensureArrows,80);
        await fillDeleteWindow();
        if(typeof toast==='function')toast('মিডিয়া মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে।');
      }else if(typeof toast==='function')toast((r&&r.message)||'ডিলেট ব্যর্থ হয়েছে।');
    }catch(e){if(typeof toast==='function')toast('ডিলেট সার্ভার ত্রুটি: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:e))}
  };

  window.minimizeFinalMediaDelete=function(){

  };

  };

  function bindDeleteButton(){

      }
    });
  }

  function refresh(){
    ensureArrows();
    bindDeleteButton();
    makeWindowDrag(document.getElementById('finalMediaDeleteWin'));
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',refresh);else refresh();
  setTimeout(refresh,300);setTimeout(refresh,800);setTimeout(refresh,1600);
  var oldRender=window.renderMedia;
  var tries=0;
  var timer=setInterval(function(){
    if(window.renderMedia!==oldRender){
      oldRender=window.renderMedia;
      tries++;
    }
    ensureArrows();bindDeleteButton();
    if(tries>30)clearInterval(timer);

<script id="media-autoplay-income-expense-fix-js-2026-09-22">
(function(){
  /* ডিলেট তালিকা না খুলেও প্রথম মিডিয়া/ভিডিও স্বাভাবিকভাবে দেখাবে */
  function autoRenderMedia(){
    try{
      if(typeof window.renderMedia==='function') window.renderMedia();
      else if(typeof renderMedia==='function') renderMedia();
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){setTimeout(autoRenderMedia,900)});
  else setTimeout(autoRenderMedia,900);
  [1800,3000].forEach(function(ms){setTimeout(autoRenderMedia,ms)});

  /* ডিলেট উইন্ডো খোলা/বন্ধ হওয়া মিডিয়া প্লেয়ারের উপর আর নির্ভর করবে না */
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#mediaDeleteBtn,[data-action="delete-media"],.media-delete-btn');
    if(b){ setTimeout(autoRenderMedia,500); }
  },true);
})();
</script>

<script id="final-true-media-autoplay-2026-09-22">
(function(){
  var busy=false;
  function getMedia(){return Array.isArray(window.media)?window.media:[]}
  function next(){
    var m=getMedia();
    if(m.length>1){mediaIndex=(Number(mediaIndex||0)+1)%m.length;window.renderMedia&&window.renderMedia();setTimeout(bind,120)}
  }
  function bind(){
    var box=document.getElementById('mediaStageContent');if(!box)return;
    var el=box.querySelector('video,audio');if(!el)return;
    el.onended=null;
    el.onended=next;
    el.autoplay=true;
    el.playsInline=true;
    el.preload='auto';
    /* ব্রাউজারের autoplay policy মেনে প্রথমে muted autoplay চেষ্টা */
    var p=el.play();
    if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
      try{el.muted=true;var q=el.play();if(q&&q.catch)q.catch(function(){})}catch(e){}
    });
  }
  async function load(){
    if(busy||typeof call!=='function'||!token)return;
    busy=true;
    try{
      var r=await call('listMedia',token);
      var m=Array.isArray(r)?r:(r&&Array.isArray(r.media)?r.media:(r&&Array.isArray(r.rows)?r.rows:null));
      if(m){window.media=m;if(media.length){mediaIndex=((Number(mediaIndex)||0)%media.length+media.length)%media.length;window.renderMedia&&window.renderMedia();setTimeout(bind,150)}}
    }catch(e){}
    busy=false;
  }
  function boot(){load();setTimeout(load,900);setTimeout(load,2200);setTimeout(bind,3000)}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('#mediaPlayBtn,.slider-action');
    if(b)setTimeout(bind,120);
  },true);
})();
</script>

<script id="dashboard-period-dynamic-large-2026-09-22">
(function(){
  var periods=['দৈনিক','সাপ্তাহিক','মাসিক','বাৎসরিক'];
  var periodIndex=0, timer=null, loading=false, refreshTimer=null;

  function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(s){return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'})[s]})}
  function money(v){
    var n=Number(v)||0;
    try{return new Intl.NumberFormat('bn-BD',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(n)}catch(e){return String(Math.round(n))}
  }
  function rangeLabel(r){
    if(!r)return '';
    return esc(r.rangeStart||'')+(r.rangeEnd&&r.rangeEnd!==r.rangeStart?' → '+esc(r.rangeEnd):'');
  }
  function renderLarge(r,period){
    var box=document.getElementById('dashboardCharts');
    if(!box)return;
    var income=Number(r&&r.income)||0, expense=Number(r&&r.expense)||0, cash=Number(r&&r.cash)||0, due=Number(r&&r.due)||0;
    var p=Number(r&&r.attendance&&r.attendance.present)||0, a=Number(r&&r.attendance&&r.attendance.absent)||0;
    var total=p+a, pct=total?Math.round(p/total*100):0, vals=[income,expense,cash,due], max=Math.max.apply(null,vals.concat([1]));
    var labels=['আয়','ব্যয়','ক্যাশ','বকেয়া'];
    var bars=vals.map(function(v,i){
      var h=Math.max(8,Math.round((v/max)*175));
      return '<div class="dashboard-period-bar-wrap">'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-bar-value">'+money(v)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-bar" style="height:'+h+'px;background:'+(i===0?'#20a464':i===1?'#e33b4a':i===2?'#248bd0':'#f0a51a')+'"></div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-label">'+labels[i]+'</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    var tabs=periods.map(function(v,i){return '<button class="period-tab '+(v===period?'active':'')+'" data-period="'+esc(v)+'" onclick="selectDashboardPeriod(this,\''+v+'\')">'+v+'</button>'}).join('');
    box.innerHTML=
      '<div class="chart-card">'+
        '<div class="chart-title">📊 আয় + ব্যয় + ক্যাশ + বকেয়া — '+esc(period)+' সামারি</div>'+
        '<div class="period-tabs">'+tabs+'</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-range">সময়কাল: '+rangeLabel(r)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-finance">'+bars+'</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-legend">'+
          '<span><i class="dashboard-period-dot" style="background:#20a464"></i>আয়</span>'+
          '<span><i class="dashboard-period-dot" style="background:#e33b4a"></i>ব্যয়</span>'+
          '<span><i class="dashboard-period-dot" style="background:#248bd0"></i>ক্যাশ</span>'+
          '<span><i class="dashboard-period-dot" style="background:#f0a51a"></i>বকেয়া</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-dynamic-badge">↻ লাইভ ডায়নামিক সামারি</div>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="chart-card">'+
        '<div class="chart-title">👥 '+esc(period)+' উপস্থিত / অনুপস্থিত</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-period-range">সময়কাল: '+rangeLabel(r)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-attendance-wrap">'+
          '<div class="dashboard-attendance-ring-large" style="--present-pct:'+pct+'%"><span>'+pct+'%</span></div>'+
          '<div class="dashboard-attendance-counts-large">'+
            '<div class="dashboard-attendance-count-large"><b>'+money(p)+'</b>উপস্থিত</div>'+
            '<div class="dashboard-attendance-count-large"><b>'+money(a)+'</b>অনুপস্থিত</div>'+
          '</div>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div class="dashboard-dynamic-badge">↻ লাইভ ডায়নামিক হাজিরা সামারি</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }

  async function load(period,keepIndex){
    if(loading||!token||typeof call!=='function')return;
    loading=true;
    try{
      var r=await call('getDashboardPeriodStats',token,period);
      if(r&&r.ok)renderLarge(r,period);
    }catch(e){
      console.warn('Dashboard period summary:',e);
    }
    loading=false;
    if(!keepIndex){
      periodIndex=periods.indexOf(period);
      if(periodIndex<0)periodIndex=0;
    }
  }

  window.selectDashboardPeriod=function(btn,period){
    periodIndex=periods.indexOf(period);
    if(periodIndex<0)periodIndex=0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#dashboardCharts .period-tab').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('active')});
    if(btn)btn.classList.add('active');
    load(period,false);
  };

  function cycle(){
    periodIndex=(periodIndex+1)%periods.length;
    load(periods[periodIndex],true);
  }
  function start(){
    if(timer)clearInterval(timer);
    timer=setInterval(cycle,8000);
    if(refreshTimer)clearInterval(refreshTimer);
    refreshTimer=setInterval(function(){load(periods[periodIndex],true)},45000);
    load(periods[periodIndex],true);
  }
  function waitForToken(){
    if(token){start();return}
    setTimeout(waitForToken,1200);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',waitForToken);
  else waitForToken();
})();
</script>

<script id="final-media-sequential-load-fix-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  var seqTimer=null, loadBusy=false;

  function list(){
    return Array.isArray(window.media)?window.media:[];
  }

  function normalise(){
    var m=list();
    if(!m.length){window.media=[];return;}
    var n=Number(window.mediaIndex);
    if(!isFinite(n))n=0;
    window.mediaIndex=((n%m.length)+m.length)%m.length;
  }

  function playCurrent(){
    var box=document.getElementById('mediaStageContent');
    if(!box)return;
    var el=box.querySelector('video,audio');
    if(el){
      el.autoplay=true;
      el.playsInline=true;
      el.preload='auto';
      var p=el.play();
      if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
        try{el.muted=true;var q=el.play();if(q&&q.catch)q.catch(function(){})}catch(e){}
      });
    }
  }

  function scheduleNext(){
    clearTimeout(seqTimer);
    var m=list();
    if(m.length<=1)return;
    var box=document.getElementById('mediaStageContent');
    if(!box)return;
    var el=box.querySelector('video,audio');
    if(el){
      el.onended=function(){
        window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%list().length;
        if(typeof window.renderMedia==='function')window.renderMedia();
        setTimeout(function(){playCurrent();scheduleNext();},120);
      };
    }else{
      /* ছবি নির্দিষ্ট সময় পরে পরের মিডিয়ায় যাবে */
      seqTimer=setTimeout(function(){
        window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%list().length;
        if(typeof window.renderMedia==='function')window.renderMedia();
        setTimeout(function(){scheduleNext();},120);
      },6000);
    }
  }

  function renderAndPlay(){
    normalise();
    if(!list().length)return;
    if(typeof window.renderMedia==='function')window.renderMedia();
    setTimeout(function(){playCurrent();scheduleNext();},100);
  }

  async function refresh(){
    if(loadBusy||typeof window.call!=='function'||!window.token)return;
    loadBusy=true;
    try{
      var r=await window.call('listMedia',window.token);
      var m=Array.isArray(r)?r:(r&&Array.isArray(r.media)?r.media:(r&&Array.isArray(r.rows)?r.rows:[]));
      window.media=m||[];
      normalise();
      if(window.media.length)renderAndPlay();
    }catch(e){}
    loadBusy=false;
  }

  /* Login/token হওয়ার পর Delete চাপা ছাড়াই মিডিয়া নিজে লোড হবে */
  function boot(){
    refresh();
    [700,1600,3000].forEach(function(ms){setTimeout(refresh,ms)});
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();

  /* Load বাটনে চাপলে আগে মিডিয়া refresh হবে; Delete লাগবে না */
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('#mediaStage .slider-center-controls .slider-action');
    if(!b)return;
    var title=(b.getAttribute('title')||'').toLowerCase();
    var txt=(b.textContent||'').toLowerCase();
    if(title.indexOf('upload')>=0||txt.indexOf('load')>=0){
      setTimeout(refresh,350);
      setTimeout(refresh,1400);
    }
    if(title.indexOf('delete')>=0||txt.indexOf('delete')>=0){
      setTimeout(refresh,600);
    }  },true);
  /* renderMedia অন্য স্ক্রিপ্ট থেকে কল হলেও sequential autoplay সচল থাকবে */
  var oldRender=window.renderMedia;
  if(typeof oldRender==='function'){
    window.renderMedia=function(){
      oldRender.apply(this,arguments);
      setTimeout(function(){playCurrent();scheduleNext();},80);
    };
  }
})();
</script>


<style id="prevent-duplicate-media-names-2026-09-23">
/* একই নামে দ্বিতীয়বার মিডিয়া লোড/সেভ হবে না */
</style>
<script id="prevent-duplicate-media-names-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  function key(v){return String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase();}
  var oldUpload=window.uploadMedia;
  if(typeof oldUpload!=='function')return;
  window.uploadMedia=async function(){
    var input=document.getElementById('mediaFiles');
    if(!input||!input.files||!input.files.length)return oldUpload.apply(this,arguments);
    var existing=Array.isArray(window.media)?window.media:[];
    var names={};
    existing.forEach(function(x){var n=key(x&&x.Name);if(n)names[n]=true;});
    var files=Array.prototype.slice.call(input.files);
    var dup=files.filter(function(f){return names[key(f.name)];});
    if(dup.length){
      if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('একই নামে ফাইল আগে থেকেই আছে: '+dup.map(function(f){return f.name}).join(', '));
      /* নতুন নামের ফাইলগুলোই শুধু আপলোড হবে */
      var dt=new DataTransfer();
      files.filter(function(f){return !names[key(f.name)];}).forEach(function(f){dt.items.add(f);});
      input.files=dt.files;
      if(!input.files.length)return;
    }
    return oldUpload.apply(this,arguments);
  };
})();
</script>

<script id="header-final-clock-news-calendar-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  function pad(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0');}
  function updateHeaderClock(){
    var now=new Date();
    var clock=document.getElementById('appClock'), date=document.getElementById('appDate');
    if(clock)clock.textContent=pad(now.getHours())+':'+pad(now.getMinutes())+':'+pad(now.getSeconds());
    if(date){
      var days=['রবিবার','সোমবার','মঙ্গলবার','বুধবার','বৃহস্পতিবার','শুক্রবার','শনিবার'];
      date.textContent=pad(now.getDate())+'-'+pad(now.getMonth()+1)+'-'+now.getFullYear()+'  '+days[now.getDay()];
    }
  }
  function setupNews(){
    document.querySelectorAll('#app > header.header .header-news-row-final .header-news').forEach(function(el){
      var txt=(el.textContent||'').trim()||'জান্নাতুল বাক্বী মহিলা মাদ্রাসা ও এতিমখানার ডিজিটাল প্লাটফর্মে আপনাকে স্বাগতম';
      el.innerHTML='';
      var track=document.createElement('span'); track.className='header-news-track';
      for(var i=0;i<2;i++){
        var item=document.createElement('span');
        item.className='header-news-item';
        item.textContent=txt;
        track.appendChild(item);
      }
      el.appendChild(track);
    });
  }
  function setupCalendar(){
    var s=document.getElementById('headerCalendarSelect');
    if(!s||s.dataset.bound)return;
    s.dataset.bound='1';
    s.onchange=function(){
      var v=s.value;
      if(!v)return;
      var d=new Date(), out='';
      if(v==='en')out='English Calendar: '+d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
      if(v==='ar')out='التقويم العربي: '+d.toLocaleDateString('ar-SA-u-ca-islamic');
      if(v==='bn')out='বাংলা ক্যালেন্ডার: '+d.toLocaleDateString('bn-BD-u-ca-beng');
      if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast(out);
      s.value='';
    };
  }
  function init(){updateHeaderClock();setupNews();setupCalendar();}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
  setInterval(updateHeaderClock,1000);
  setTimeout(init,700);
})();
</script>

<script id="header-slide-delete-list-final-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  function getData(){
    if(typeof window.__getHeaderSlideList==='function'){
      try{return window.__getHeaderSlideList();}catch(e){}
    }
    var box=document.getElementById('headerBackgroundSlides');
    var imgs=box?box.querySelectorAll('.header-background-slide'):[];
    return Array.prototype.map.call(imgs,function(img,i){
      return {src:img.src,label:img.alt||('Header Slide '+(i+1)),index:i};
    });
  }
  function ensureWindow(){
    var w=document.getElementById('headerSlideDeleteWindow');
    if(w)return w;
    w=document.createElement('div');
    w.id='headerSlideDeleteWindow';
    w.innerHTML='<div class="hsdw-head"><span>Header ছবির তালিকা — যেটি চান ডিলেট করুন</span><button type="button" class="hsdw-close" onclick="closeHeaderSlideDeleteList()">✕</button></div><div class="hsdw-body" id="headerSlideDeleteList"></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(w);
    return w;
  }
  function renderList(){
    var w=ensureWindow(), list=document.getElementById('headerSlideDeleteList');
    var data=getData();
    list.innerHTML='';
    if(!data.length){
      list.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;font-weight:900;padding:25px">কোনো Header স্লাইড নেই</div>';
      return;
    }
    data.forEach(function(x){
      var row=document.createElement('div');
      row.className='hsdw-item';
      row.innerHTML='<img src="'+x.src.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" alt=""><div class="hsdw-name">'+String(x.label).replace(/[<>&"]/g,function(s){return {'<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','&':'&amp;','"':'&quot;'}[s]})+'</div><button type="button" class="hsdw-del">🗑 ডিলেট</button>';
      row.querySelector('.hsdw-del').onclick=function(){
        window.deleteHeaderSlideByListIndex(x.index);
      };
      list.appendChild(row);
    });
    w.classList.add('show');
  }
  window.deleteHeaderSlideByListIndex=function(i){    /* মূল slider-এর render/arrays-এর ভেতরের delete function ব্যবহার */
    if(typeof window.deleteCurrentHeaderSlide!=='function')return;
    var all=window.__headerSlideDeleteState;    if(!all||!Array.isArray(all))return;
    if(i<0||i>=all.length)return;
    /* বর্তমান slider index-এ নিয়ে গিয়ে authoritative delete চালানো */
    try{
      if(typeof window.__setHeaderSlideIndex==='function')window.__setHeaderSlideIndex(i);
      window.deleteCurrentHeaderSlide();
      setTimeout(renderList,80);
    }catch(e){}
  };
  window.openHeaderSlideDeleteList=function(){
    renderList();
  };
  window.closeHeaderSlideDeleteList=function(){
    var w=document.getElementById('headerSlideDeleteWindow');
    if(w)w.classList.remove('show');
  };
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('#headerSlideDeleteBtn');
    if(!b)return;
    e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    renderList();
  },true);
})();
</script>

<script id="header-slide-delete-state-bridge-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  /* Final bridge: use the original slider's private index setter/delete function.
     Do not override either function; the original slider already exposes both correctly. */
  function sync(){
    try{
      var data=typeof window.__getHeaderSlideList==='function'?window.__getHeaderSlideList():[];
      window.__headerSlideDeleteState=data;
    }catch(e){window.__headerSlideDeleteState=[];}
  }
  sync();
  setInterval(sync,500);
})();
</script>

<script id="header-calendar-full-month-final-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  var state={cal:'en',cursor:new Date()};
  var cfg={
    en:{locale:'en-GB',label:'ইংরেজী ক্যালেন্ডার',week:['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']},
    ar:{locale:'ar-SA-u-ca-islamic',label:'আরবী ক্যালেন্ডার',week:['الأحد','الإثنين','الثلاثاء','الأربعاء','الخميس','الجمعة','السبت']},
    bn:{locale:'bn-BD-u-ca-beng',label:'বাংলা ক্যালেন্ডার',week:['রবি','সোম','মঙ্গল','বুধ','বৃহস্পতি','শুক্র','শনি']}
  };
  function parts(d,locale){
    var a=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale,{year:'numeric',month:'numeric',day:'numeric'}).formatToParts(d),o={};
    a.forEach(function(x){if(x.type!=='literal')o[x.type]=x.value});
    return o;
  }
  function monthKey(d,locale){
    var p=parts(d,locale);return p.year+'|'+p.month;
  }
  function monthLabel(d,locale){
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale,{year:'numeric',month:'long'}).format(d);
  }
  function makeDays(){
    var locale=cfg[state.cal].locale, cur=state.cursor;
    var target=monthKey(cur,locale), arr=[], start=new Date(cur.getTime());
    start.setDate(start.getDate()-45);
    for(var i=0;i<140;i++){
      var d=new Date(start.getTime());d.setDate(start.getDate()+i);
      if(monthKey(d,locale)===target)arr.push(d);
    }
    return arr;
  }
  function render(){
    var w=document.getElementById('headerCalendarWindow');if(!w)return;
    var c=cfg[state.cal], days=makeDays(), grid=w.querySelector('.hc-grid'), label=w.querySelector('.hc-month-label');
    label.textContent=c.label+' — '+monthLabel(state.cursor,c.locale);
    grid.innerHTML='';
    c.week.forEach(function(x){
      var h=document.createElement('div');h.className='hc-weekday';h.textContent=x;grid.appendChild(h);
    });
    var first=days[0], lead=first?first.getDay():0;
    for(var z=0;z<lead;z++){var e=document.createElement('div');e.className='hc-day empty';grid.appendChild(e);}
    var today=new Date(), todayKey=monthKey(today,c.locale)+'|'+parts(today,c.locale).day;
    days.forEach(function(d){
      var p=parts(d,c.locale), cell=document.createElement('div');cell.className='hc-day';
      if(monthKey(d,c.locale)+'|'+p.day===todayKey)cell.classList.add('today');
      cell.innerHTML='<div><div class="num">'+p.day+'</div><span class="greg">'+d.getDate()+'-'+(d.getMonth()+1)+'</span></div>';
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    });
  }
  function ensure(){
    var w=document.getElementById('headerCalendarWindow');
    if(w)return w;
    w=document.createElement('div');w.id='headerCalendarWindow';
    w.innerHTML='<div class="hc-head"><button class="hc-nav" id="hcPrev">‹</button><div class="hc-title">ক্যালেন্ডার</div><button class="hc-nav" id="hcNext">›</button><button class="hc-close" onclick="closeHeaderCalendar()">✕</button></div><div class="hc-body"><div class="hc-month-label"></div><div class="hc-grid"></div></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(w);
    w.querySelector('#hcPrev').onclick=function(){state.cursor.setMonth(state.cursor.getMonth()-1);render();};
    w.querySelector('#hcNext').onclick=function(){state.cursor.setMonth(state.cursor.getMonth()+1);render();};
    return w;
  }
  window.openHeaderCalendar=function(cal){
    state.cal=cal||'en';state.cursor=new Date();
    ensure().classList.add('show');render();
  };
  window.closeHeaderCalendar=function(){
    var w=document.getElementById('headerCalendarWindow');if(w)w.classList.remove('show');
  };
  var t=setInterval(function(){
    var s=document.getElementById('headerCalendarSelect');
    if(!s)return;
    clearInterval(t);
    s.onchange=function(){
      var v=s.value;if(!v)return;
      openHeaderCalendar(v);
      s.value='';
    };
  },100);
})();
</script>

  function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}
  function photoUrl(v){
    var s=String(v==null?'':v).trim();
    if(!s)return '';
    if(/^data:image\//i.test(s))return s;
    if(/^DRIVE:/i.test(s))return 'https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id='+encodeURIComponent(s.slice(6).trim())+'&sz=w800';
    var m=s.match(/(?:[?&]id=|\/d\/|\/file\/d\/|open\?id=)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})/i);

  }

<script id="final-search-profile-photo-actions-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  function photoCandidates(src){
    var s=String(src||'').trim(), out=[];
    if(!s)return out;
    if(/^data:image\//i.test(s))return [s];
    var m=s.match(/(?:[?&]id=|\/d\/|\/file\/d\/|open\?id=)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})/i);
    if(!m && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$/.test(s))m=[s,s];
    if(m){
      var id=m[1]||m[0];
      out.push('https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id='+encodeURIComponent(id));
      out.push('https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id='+encodeURIComponent(id)+'&sz=w1000');
      return out;
    }
    if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(s))out.push(s);
    return out;
  }
  function fixPhotos(root){
    root=root||document;
    root.querySelectorAll('#searchProfilePrint .sp-photo').forEach(function(img){
      if(img.dataset.photoFinal==='1')return;
      var src=img.getAttribute('src')||'';
      var cs=photoCandidates(src);
      if(!cs.length)return;
      img.dataset.photoFinal='1';
      var n=0;
      function next(){
        if(n>=cs.length)return;
        img.src=cs[n++];
      }
      img.onerror=next;
      next();
    });
  }
  function ensureActions(){
    var p=document.getElementById('searchProfilePrint');
    if(!p)return;
    var old=p.querySelector('.sp-bottom-actions');
    if(old)return;
    var d=document.createElement('div');
    d.className='sp-bottom-actions';
    d.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="primary">💾 সেভ</button><button type="button" class="secondary">✏️ এডিট</button><button type="button" class="secondary">🖨️ প্রিন্ট</button><button type="button" class="secondary">⬇️ ডাউনলোড</button>';
    d.children[0].onclick=function(){if(typeof window.saveSearchProfile==='function')window.saveSearchProfile();};
    d.children[1].onclick=function(){if(typeof window.editSearchProfile==='function')window.editSearchProfile();};
    d.children[2].onclick=function(){if(typeof window.printSearchProfile==='function')window.printSearchProfile();};
    d.children[3].onclick=function(){if(typeof window.downloadSearchProfile==='function')window.downloadSearchProfile();};
    p.appendChild(d);
  }
  function run(){ensureActions();fixPhotos(document);}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);else run();
  new MutationObserver(function(){run();}).observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true});
})();
</script>

<script id="search-profile-a4-pad-3col-js-2026-09-23">
(function(){

<script id="final-direct-video-media-live-fix-js-2026-09-23">
(function(){
  var loading=false, timer=null;

  function arr(){ return Array.isArray(window.media)?window.media:[]; }
  function norm(){
    var m=arr(); if(!m.length){window.media=[];window.mediaIndex=0;return;}
    var n=Number(window.mediaIndex); if(!isFinite(n))n=0;
    window.mediaIndex=((n%m.length)+m.length)%m.length;
  }
  function direct(x){
    return String((x&&(
      x.DirectURL||x.DataURL||x.Url||x.URL||x.FileURL||x.fileUrl
    ))||'').trim();
  }
  function typeOf(x){return String(x&& (x.Type||x.type)||'').toLowerCase();}
  function esc(v){
    return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){      return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
    });
  }

  function draw(){
    norm();
    var box=document.getElementById('mediaStageContent');
    if(!box)return;
    var m=arr();
    if(!m.length){
      box.innerHTML='<span class="media-empty">মিডিয়া আপলোড করে স্লাইড দেখুন</span>';
      renderList();
      return;
    }
    var x=m[window.mediaIndex]||{}, t=typeOf(x), u=direct(x);
    box.innerHTML='';
    if(t==='video'){
      var v=document.createElement('video');
      v.className='media-direct-player';
      v.controls=true;
      v.playsInline=true;
      v.preload='auto';
      v.muted=true;
      if(u)v.src=u;
      v.addEventListener('ended',function(){
        var a=arr();if(!a.length)return;
        window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%a.length;
        draw();
        autoplay();
      });
      v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',function(){autoplay();},{once:true});
      v.addEventListener('canplay',function(){autoplay();},{once:true});
      v.addEventListener('error',function(){});
      box.appendChild(v);
      setTimeout(autoplay,60);
    }else if(t==='audio'){
      var a=document.createElement('audio');
      a.controls=true;a.preload='auto';a.src=u;
      a.addEventListener('ended',function(){
        var m2=arr();if(!m2.length)return;
        window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%m2.length;
        draw();autoplay();
      });
      box.appendChild(a);
      setTimeout(autoplay,60);
    }else{
      var im=document.createElement('img');
      im.src=u;im.alt=String(x.Name||'');
      im.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;background:#111';
      im.addEventListener('error',function(){box.innerHTML='<span class="media-empty">ফটো চালানো যাচ্ছে না।</span>'});
      box.appendChild(im);
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer=setTimeout(function(){
        var a=arr();if(a.length<=1)return;
        window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%a.length;
        draw();
      },6000);
    }
    renderList();
  }

  function autoplay(){
    var v=document.querySelector('#mediaStageContent video.media-direct-player,#mediaStageContent audio');
    if(!v)return;
    try{
      v.muted=true;
      var p=v.play();      if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){});
    }catch(e){}
  }

  function renderList(){    var box=document.getElementById('mediaList');if(!box)return;
    var m=arr();
    box.innerHTML=m.map(function(x,i){
      var active=(i===Number(window.mediaIndex||0))?' style="font-weight:900"':'';
      return '<div class="media-list-item"><span'+active+'>'+esc(x.Name||('Media '+(i+1)))+'</span>'+
        '<button type="button" class="secondary" data-direct-media-delete="'+i+'">🗑 Delete</button></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  async function refresh(){
    if(loading||typeof window.call!=='function'||!window.token)return;
    loading=true;
    try{
      var r=await window.call('listMedia',window.token);
      var m=Array.isArray(r)?r:(r&&Array.isArray(r.media)?r.media:(r&&Array.isArray(r.rows)?r.rows:[]));
      window.media=m||[];
      norm();
      draw();
    }catch(e){}
    loading=false;
  }

  async function del(i){
    var m=arr(), x=m[i];if(!x)return;
    try{
      var r=await window.call('deleteMedia',window.token,x.Serial);
      if(r&&r.ok){
        m.splice(i,1);
        if(window.mediaIndex>=m.length)window.mediaIndex=Math.max(0,m.length-1);
        draw();
        renderList();
        setTimeout(refresh,100);
        if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('মিডিয়া মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে।');
      }else if(typeof window.toast==='function'){
        window.toast((r&&r.message)||'ডিলিট ব্যর্থ');
      }
    }catch(e){
      if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('ডিলিটে সার্ভার ত্রুটি হয়েছে।');
    }
  }

  window.renderMedia=draw;
  window.renderMediaList=renderList;
  window.deleteMediaByIndex=del;
  window.nextMedia=function(){
    var m=arr();if(!m.length)return;
    window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%m.length;draw();autoplay();
  };
  window.prevMedia=function(){
    var m=arr();if(!m.length)return;
    window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)-1+m.length)%m.length;draw();autoplay();
  };
  window.toggleMediaPlay=function(){autoplay()};

  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('[data-direct-media-delete]');
    if(b){
      e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
      del(Number(b.getAttribute('data-direct-media-delete')));
      return;
    }
  },true);

  function boot(){
    refresh();
    var tries=0;
    clearInterval(window.__mediaDirectLiveTimer);
    window.__mediaDirectLiveTimer=setInterval(function(){
      if(window.token){refresh();tries++;if(tries>=12)clearInterval(window.__mediaDirectLiveTimer);}
    },1000);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();

  var oldUpload=window.uploadMedia;
  if(typeof oldUpload==='function'){
    window.uploadMedia=async function(){
      var r=await oldUpload.apply(this,arguments);
      setTimeout(refresh,150);
      setTimeout(refresh,900);
      return r;
    };
  }
})();
</script>

        '<label>নম্বর '+i+' / Marks<input id="mrMark'+i+'" class="field" type="number" min="0" max="100" placeholder="০-১০০"></label>'+
        '<label>গ্রেড '+i+' / Grade<input id="mrGrade'+i+'" class="field" placeholder="ঐচ্ছিক"></label>'+
      '</div>';
    }
    return '<div class="student-meta-row-2026">'+
      '<label>আইডি লিখুন<input id="mrStudentID" class="field"></label>'+
      '<label>জন্ম তারিখ লিখুন<input id="mrDob" class="field" type="date"></label>'+

        classOptions.map(x=>'<option>'+x+'</option>').join('')+
      '</select></label>'+
      '<label>পরীক্ষা<input id="mrExam" class="field"></label>'+

  }

  function fillSubjects2026(){
    const cls=document.getElementById('mrClass');
    const list=SUBJECTS_12_2026[(cls&&cls.value)||'']||[];
    for(let i=1;i<=12;i++){
      const s=document.getElementById('mrSubject'+i);
      if(!s)continue;
      const old=s.value;
      s.innerHTML='<option value="">বিষয় নির্বাচন করুন</option>'+list.map(x=>'<option value="'+String(x).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'">'+x+'</option>').join('');
      if(list.indexOf(old)>=0)s.value=old;
    }
  }

  window.loadMarkResultSubjects2026=fillSubjects2026;
  window.saveMarkResult2026=async function(k){
    const subjects=[];
    for(let i=1;i<=12;i++){
      const name=document.getElementById('mrSubject'+i)?.value||'';
      const mark=document.getElementById('mrMark'+i)?.value||'';
      const grade=document.getElementById('mrGrade'+i)?.value||'';
      if(name)subjects.push({Subject:name,Marks:mark,Grade:grade});
    }
    const d={
      StudentID:document.getElementById('mrStudent')?.value||document.getElementById('mrStudentID')?.value||'',
      Name:document.getElementById('mrName')?.value||'',
      Class:document.getElementById('mrClass')?.value||'',
      Exam:document.getElementById('mrExam')?.value||'',
      SubjectData:JSON.stringify(subjects),
      Total:subjects.reduce((a,x)=>a+(Number(x.Marks)||0),0),
      Published:'NO',
      Date:document.getElementById('mrRecordDate')?.value||new Date().toISOString(),
      DOB:document.getElementById('mrDob')?.value||''
    };
    try{
      const r=await call('saveRecord',token,'RESULTS',d);
      toast(r.ok?'সফলভাবে সংরক্ষণ হয়েছে':(r.message||'সংরক্ষণ ব্যর্থ'));
    }catch(e){toast('সংরক্ষণে সার্ভার ত্রুটি হয়েছে।');}
  };

  const oldModuleForm=window.moduleForm;
  if(typeof oldModuleForm==='function'){
    window.moduleForm=function(k){
      if(k==='marks'||k==='result')return subjectForm2026(k);
      return oldModuleForm(k);
    };
  }

  const style=document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent='.mr-subject-title-2026{margin-top:12px;padding:9px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;font-weight:900;text-align:center}.mr-subject-2026{font-weight:800}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
})();

<script id="media-playback-stable-fix-js-2026-09-30">
(function(){
  function list(){return Array.isArray(window.media)?window.media:[]}
  function idOf(x){var s=String((x&&x.FileID)||(x&&x.DriveFileId)||'');if(s)return s;s=String((x&&x.DataURL)||'');var m=s.match(/[?&]id=([^&]+)/)||s.match(/\/d\/([^/]+)/);return m?decodeURIComponent(m[1]):''}
  function resourceOf(x){return String((x&&x.ResourceKey)||'').trim()}
  function previewOf(x){var id=idOf(x);if(!id)return String((x&&x.PreviewURL)||'');var rk=resourceOf(x);return 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'/preview'+(rk?'?resourcekey='+encodeURIComponent(rk):'')}
  function directOf(x){var u=String((x&&x.DirectURL)||(x&&x.DataURL)||'').trim();if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)&&u.indexOf('drive.google.com/uc?')>=0)return u;var id=idOf(x);if(!id)return u;var rk=resourceOf(x);return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id='+encodeURIComponent(id)+(rk?'&resourcekey='+encodeURIComponent(rk):'')}
  function renderStable(){
    var box=document.getElementById('mediaStageContent'),m=list();if(!box)return;
    if(!m.length){box.innerHTML='<span class="media-empty">মিডিয়া আপলোড করে স্লাইড দেখুন</span>';return}
    var n=Number(window.mediaIndex||0);if(!isFinite(n))n=0;window.mediaIndex=((n%m.length)+m.length)%m.length;
    var x=m[window.mediaIndex]||{},t=String(x.Type||x.type||'').toLowerCase();box.innerHTML='';
    if(t==='video'){
      var fr=document.createElement('iframe');fr.className='media-stable-frame';fr.allow='autoplay; fullscreen; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture';fr.setAttribute('allowfullscreen','');fr.setAttribute('referrerpolicy','no-referrer-when-downgrade');fr.src=previewOf(x);box.appendChild(fr);
    }else if(t==='audio'){
      var a=document.createElement('audio');a.controls=true;a.preload='metadata';a.src=directOf(x);a.style.cssText='width:90%;max-height:80px';box.appendChild(a);
    }else if(t==='image'){
      var im=document.createElement('img');im.src=directOf(x);im.alt=String(x.Name||x.name||'');im.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#111;display:block';box.appendChild(im);
    }else box.innerHTML='<span class="media-empty">মিডিয়ার ধরন পাওয়া যায়নি।</span>';
    if(typeof window.renderMediaList==='function')window.renderMediaList();
  }
  window.renderMedia=renderStable;
  window.nextMedia=function(){var m=list();if(!m.length)return;window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)+1)%m.length;renderStable()};
  window.prevMedia=function(){var m=list();if(!m.length)return;window.mediaIndex=(Number(window.mediaIndex||0)-1+m.length)%m.length;renderStable()};
  window.toggleMediaPlay=function(){var f=document.querySelector('#mediaStageContent .media-stable-frame');if(f)f.focus();var v=document.querySelector('#mediaStageContent video.media-stable-video,#mediaStageContent audio');if(v){if(v.paused){var p=v.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){})}else v.pause()}};
})();
</script>

<script id="jb-universal-fullscreen-js-2026">
(function(){
  function isTarget(w){return w&&((w.classList&&(w.classList.contains('window')||w.classList.contains('form-window')))||w.id==='formWin')}
  function toggle(w){
    if(!isTarget(w))return;
    if(w.classList.contains('jb-universal-fullscreen-2026')){
      w.classList.remove('jb-universal-fullscreen-2026');
      w.style.width=w.dataset.jbFsWidth||'';w.style.height=w.dataset.jbFsHeight||'';w.style.maxHeight=w.dataset.jbFsMaxHeight||'';
      w.style.left=w.dataset.jbFsLeft||'';w.style.top=w.dataset.jbFsTop||'';w.style.transform=w.dataset.jbFsTransform||'';
    }else{
      var r=w.getBoundingClientRect();
      w.dataset.jbFsWidth=w.style.width||r.width+'px';w.dataset.jbFsHeight=w.style.height||r.height+'px';w.dataset.jbFsMaxHeight=w.style.maxHeight||'';
      w.dataset.jbFsLeft=w.style.left||r.left+'px';w.dataset.jbFsTop=w.style.top||r.top+'px';w.dataset.jbFsTransform=w.style.transform||'';
      w.classList.add('jb-universal-fullscreen-2026');
    }
  }
  function add(w){
    if(!isTarget(w))return;
    var head=w.querySelector('.win-head');if(!head)return;
    var b=head.querySelector('.jb-universal-fs-2026');
    if(!b){
      b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='jb-universal-fs-2026';b.textContent='⛶';b.title='ফুল স্ক্রিন / স্বাভাবিক';b.setAttribute('aria-label','ফুল স্ক্রিন / স্বাভাবিক');
      var controls=head.querySelector('.task3-window-controls');
      if(controls)controls.insertBefore(b,controls.lastElementChild||null);else head.appendChild(b);
    }
    if(b.dataset.jbBound==='1')return;b.dataset.jbBound='1';
    b.onclick=function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();toggle(w)};
  }
  function scan(){document.querySelectorAll('.window,.form-window').forEach(add);var f=document.getElementById('formWin');if(f)add(f)}
  window.jbUniversalFullscreen2026=toggle;
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',scan);else scan();
  setTimeout(scan,300);setTimeout(scan,1000);/* Removed redundant polling; DOM observer handles new UI. */
  new MutationObserver(function(ms){ms.forEach(function(m){m.addedNodes&&m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){if(n.nodeType===1){if(n.matches&&n.matches('.window,.form-window,#formWin'))add(n);n.querySelectorAll&&n.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(add)}})})}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})();
</script>

(function(){

  function setContactQR(url){

  }

(function(){

  function qr(url){
    return 'https://quickchart.io/qr?size=220&margin=2&text='+encodeURIComponent(url)+'&v='+Date.now();

  function logoSrc(){

  }
  function ensureHeader(){
    var p=document.getElementById('searchProfilePrint');
    if(!p)return;
    var h=p.querySelector('.search-profile-head');
    if(!h)return;
    var logo=h.querySelector('.sp-logo');
    var q=h.querySelector('.sp-qr');

      logo=document.createElement('img');

    if(ls)logo.src=ls;
    if(!q){
      q=document.createElement('img');

  function print(){

<script id="central-document-builder-qr-verification-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  function escQ(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');}
  function b64(s){try{return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)));}catch(e){return btoa(String(s));}}
  function docVerifyUrl(base,key,id){
    base=String(base||window.location.href||'').split('#')[0];
    var q='verify=1&doc='+encodeURIComponent(key)+'&id='+encodeURIComponent(id);
    return base+(base.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+q;
  }
  function renderQR(box,url){
    box.setAttribute('data-qr',url);
    box.innerHTML='';
    try{
      if(window.QRCode){new QRCode(box,{text:url,width:110,height:110});}
      else box.textContent=url;
    }catch(e){box.textContent=url;}
  }
  function addQR(container,key,id){
    if(!container||!id)return;
    var box=document.createElement('div');
    box.style.cssText='text-align:center;margin:12px auto;padding:8px;border:1px dashed #777;width:max-content;background:#fff';
    box.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px">QR যাচাই</div><div class="jb-qr-box"></div><small>Document ID: '+escQ(id)+'</small>';
    container.appendChild(box);
    var qrBox=box.querySelector('.jb-qr-box');
    var fallback=docVerifyUrl(window.location.href,key,id);
    renderQR(qrBox,fallback);
    try{
      if(typeof call==='function'){
        call('getMainWebAppUrl').then(function(r){
          if(r&&r.ok&&r.url) renderQR(qrBox,docVerifyUrl(String(r.url).trim(),key,id));
        }).catch(function(){});
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  window.jbAddVerificationQR=function(key,id){
    var p=document.getElementById('jbDocPreview');
    if(!p)return;
    var old=p.querySelector('.jb-verification-qr');if(old)old.remove();
    var holder=document.createElement('div');holder.className='jb-verification-qr';
    p.appendChild(holder);addQR(holder,key,id);
  };
  window.jbVerifyDocument=async function(key,id){
    try{
      var r=await call('getDocumentVerification','',key,id);
      var p=document.getElementById('jbDocPreviewWrap')||document.body;
      var old=document.getElementById('jbDocVerifyResult');if(old)old.remove();
      var d=document.createElement('div');d.id='jbDocVerifyResult';d.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:999999;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);max-width:420px;width:90%;padding:22px;border:4px solid #222;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.35);text-align:center';
      if(r&&r.verified){
        d.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:28px">✅</div><h3>ডকুমেন্ট যাচাই সফল</h3><p><b>Document ID:</b> '+escQ(r.recordId)+'</p><p><b>Student ID:</b> '+escQ(r.studentId)+'</p><p><b>নাম:</b> '+escQ(r.name)+'</p><p><b>শ্রেণি:</b> '+escQ(r.className)+'</p><p>'+escQ(r.message)+'</p>';
      }else d.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:28px">❌</div><h3>ডকুমেন্ট যাচাই হয়নি</h3><p>'+escQ((r&&r.message)||'রেকর্ড পাওয়া যায়নি।')+'</p>';
      var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.textContent='বন্ধ করুন';btn.className='secondary';btn.onclick=function(){d.remove();};d.appendChild(btn);
      document.body.appendChild(d);
    }catch(e){toast('যাচাই করা যায়নি: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:e));}
  };
  var oldCreate=window.jbCreatePreview;
  if(typeof oldCreate==='function'){
    window.jbCreatePreview=function(){

        var id=(document.getElementById('jbDocId')?.value||'').trim();
        if(key&&id&&window.jbAddVerificationQR) window.jbAddVerificationQR(key,id);
      },80);
      return r;
    };
  }
  window.addEventListener('load',function(){
    var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if(q.get('verify')==='1'&&q.get('doc')&&q.get('id')){

<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — AUTO SAVE DRAFT + RESTORE — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-autosave-restore-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  var DKEY='jbDocAutoDraft2026';
  var timer=null;
  function E(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
  function key(){
    var t=E('jbDocBuilderTitle')?.textContent||'';
    return t.indexOf('মার্কশিট')>=0?'marks':t.indexOf('ফলাফল')>=0?'result':t.indexOf('আইডি কার্ড')>=0?'id_cards':t.indexOf('অ্যাডমিট কার্ড')>=0?'admit_cards':t.indexOf('সার্টিফিকেট')>=0?'certificates':t.indexOf('মানি রিসিট')>=0?'receipts':'marks';
  }
  function collect(){
    var data={};document.querySelectorAll('#jbDocFields [data-key]').forEach(function(x){data[x.dataset.key]=x.value||''});
    return {key:key(),id:(E('jbDocId')?.value||'').trim(),data:data,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  }
  function saveAuto(){
    if(!E('jbDocBuilderWin')?.classList.contains('show')||!E('jbDocFields'))return;
    var d=collect();if(!d.id&&!Object.values(d.data).some(Boolean))return;
    try{localStorage.setItem(DKEY,JSON.stringify(d));var s=E('jbDocAutoStatus');if(s)s.textContent='📝 Draft auto-save: '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('bn-BD')}catch(e){}
  }
  function restore(d){
    if(!d)return;
    if(E('jbDocId'))E('jbDocId').value=d.id||'';
    Object.keys(d.data||{}).forEach(function(k){var e=document.querySelector('#jbDocFields [data-key="'+CSS.escape(k)+'"]');if(e)e.value=d.data[k]==null?'':d.data[k]});
    if(typeof toast==='function')toast('♻️ Draft পুনরুদ্ধার হয়েছে। এখন তথ্য যাচাই করে Document তৈরি করুন।');
  }
  function offer(){
    var raw;try{raw=localStorage.getItem(DKEY)}catch(e){return} if(!raw)return;
    var d;try{d=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){return} if(!d||!d.data)return;
    var box=E('jbDocDraftRestore');if(box)box.remove();
    box=document.createElement('div');box.id='jbDocDraftRestore';box.className='jb-doc-note';
    box.style.cssText='position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;margin:8px 0;padding:10px;border:2px solid #b8860b;background:#fff8dc';
    var when=d.updatedAt?new Date(d.updatedAt).toLocaleString('bn-BD'):'আগের কোনো সময়';
    box.innerHTML='<b>📝 সংরক্ষিত Draft পাওয়া গেছে</b><br><span>শেষ Auto-save: '+esc(when)+'</span> ';
    var yes=document.createElement('button');yes.className='primary';yes.textContent='♻️ পুনরুদ্ধার';yes.onclick=function(){restore(d);box.remove()};
    var no=document.createElement('button');no.className='secondary';no.textContent='✖️ বাদ দিন';no.onclick=function(){try{localStorage.removeItem(DKEY)}catch(e){}box.remove()};
    box.appendChild(yes);box.appendChild(no);
    var fields=E('jbDocFields');if(fields&&fields.parentNode)fields.parentNode.insertBefore(box,fields);
  }
  function start(){clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(saveAuto,10000);setTimeout(offer,300)}
  var oldOpen=window.openBuilder;
  if(typeof oldOpen==='function')window.openBuilder=function(){var r=oldOpen.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(start,500);return r};
  window.jbAutoSaveDraft=saveAuto;
  window.jbRestoreAutoDraft=function(){offer()};
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',saveAuto);
  window.addEventListener('load',function(){setTimeout(offer,800)});
})();
</script>
<!-- ===== END AUTO SAVE DRAFT + RESTORE ===== -->

<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — DRAFT LIFECYCLE SAFETY — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-draft-lifecycle-safety-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  var DKEY='jbDocAutoDraft2026';
  function currentKey(){
    var t=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderTitle')?.textContent||'';
    return t.indexOf('মার্কশিট')>=0?'marks':t.indexOf('ফলাফল')>=0?'result':t.indexOf('আইডি কার্ড')>=0?'id_cards':t.indexOf('অ্যাডমিট কার্ড')>=0?'admit_cards':t.indexOf('সার্টিফিকেট')>=0?'certificates':t.indexOf('মানি রিসিট')>=0?'receipts':'marks';
  }
  function clearStored(){try{localStorage.removeItem(DKEY)}catch(e){}}
  var oldSave=window.jbSaveDraft;
  if(typeof oldSave==='function')window.jbSaveDraft=async function(){
    var r=await oldSave.apply(this,arguments);
    /* Final server save completed; prevent an old Draft from reappearing. */
    clearStored();
    return r;
  };
  var oldClear=window.jbClearDoc;
  if(typeof oldClear==='function')window.jbClearDoc=function(){clearStored();return oldClear.apply(this,arguments)};
  var oldRestore=window.jbRestoreAutoDraft;
  if(typeof oldRestore==='function')window.jbRestoreAutoDraft=function(){return oldRestore.apply(this,arguments)};
  /* Only offer a Draft for the currently opened document type. */
  var oldOpen=window.openBuilder;
  if(typeof oldOpen==='function')window.openBuilder=function(){
    var r=oldOpen.apply(this,arguments);
    setTimeout(function(){
      try{
        var raw=localStorage.getItem(DKEY);if(!raw)return;
        var d=JSON.parse(raw);if(d&&d.key&&d.key!==currentKey()){localStorage.removeItem(DKEY);}
      }catch(e){}
    },700);
    return r;
  };
})();
</script>

<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — DRAFT SAVE SUCCESS SAFETY FIX — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-draft-save-success-safety-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  var DKEY='jbDocAutoDraft2026';
  function key(){
    var t=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderTitle')?.textContent||'';
    return t.indexOf('মার্কশিট')>=0?'marks':t.indexOf('ফলাফল')>=0?'result':t.indexOf('আইডি কার্ড')>=0?'id_cards':t.indexOf('অ্যাডমিট কার্ড')>=0?'admit_cards':t.indexOf('সার্টিফিকেট')>=0?'certificates':t.indexOf('মানি রিসিট')>=0?'receipts':'marks';
  }
  function clearStored(){try{localStorage.removeItem(DKEY)}catch(e){}}
  function saveSafely(){
    var p=document.getElementById('jbDocPreviewWrap')?.querySelector('.jb-doc-preview');
    if(!p)return toast('আগে Document তৈরি করুন।');
    var id=(document.getElementById('jbDocId')?.value||'').trim();
    if(!id)return toast('Student ID প্রয়োজন।');
    var data={};
    document.querySelectorAll('#jbDocFields [data-key]').forEach(function(x){data[x.dataset.key]=x.value||''});
    var draftRaw=null;
    try{draftRaw=localStorage.getItem(DKEY)}catch(e){}
    return call('saveDocumentBuilderRecord',token,key(),id,data,p.outerHTML).then(function(r){
      if(r&&r.ok){
        clearStored();
        toast('💾 Document + History-তে সংরক্ষণ হয়েছে। Draft মুছে দেওয়া হয়েছে।');
      }else{
        if(draftRaw!==null)try{localStorage.setItem(DKEY,draftRaw)}catch(e){}
        toast((r&&r.message)||'সার্ভারে সংরক্ষণ হয়নি। Draft নিরাপদে রাখা হয়েছে।');
      }
      return r;
    }).catch(function(e){
      if(draftRaw!==null)try{localStorage.setItem(DKEY,draftRaw)}catch(x){}
      toast('সার্ভারে সংরক্ষণ হয়নি: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:e)+' — Draft নিরাপদে রাখা হয়েছে।');
      return {ok:false,message:e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)};
    });
  }
  window.jbSaveDraft=saveSafely;
})();
</script>
<!-- ===== END DRAFT SAVE SUCCESS SAFETY FIX ===== -->


<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — EDIT SYNC SAFETY — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-edit-sync-safety-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  function syncPreviewToFields(){
    var wrap=document.getElementById('jbDocPreviewWrap');
    var fields=document.querySelectorAll('#jbDocFields [data-key]');
    if(!wrap||!fields.length)return;
    var map={};
    fields.forEach(function(inp){
      var lab=inp.closest('.jb-doc-field')?.querySelector('label');
      if(lab){
        var text=Array.from(lab.childNodes).map(function(n){return n.nodeType===3?n.textContent:''}).join('').trim();        if(text&&!map[text])map[text]=inp;
      }
    });
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.jb-doc-row').forEach(function(row){
      var b=row.querySelector('b'), span=row.querySelector('[contenteditable]');
      if(!b||!span)return;
      var inp=map[b.textContent.trim()];
      if(!inp)return;
      span.dataset.jbEditKey=inp.dataset.key;
      span.oninput=function(){inp.value=span.textContent.trim()};
      span.onblur=function(){inp.value=span.textContent.trim()};
    });
  }
  var oldCreate=window.jbCreatePreview;
  if(typeof oldCreate==='function'){
    window.jbCreatePreview=function(){
      var r=oldCreate.apply(this,arguments);
      setTimeout(syncPreviewToFields,0);
      return r;
    };
  }
  var oldEdit=window.jbEditPreview;
  if(typeof oldEdit==='function'){
    window.jbEditPreview=function(){
      var r=oldEdit.apply(this,arguments);
      syncPreviewToFields();
      return r;
    };
  }
  window.jbSyncPreviewToFields2026=syncPreviewToFields;
  setTimeout(syncPreviewToFields,500);
})();
</script>
<!-- ===== END EDIT SYNC SAFETY ===== -->

<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — QR RENDER TARGET FIX — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-qr-render-target-fix-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  function renderSavedQR(key,id){
    var wrap=document.getElementById('jbDocPreviewWrap');
    var p=wrap&&wrap.querySelector('.jb-doc-preview');
    if(!p||!id)return;
    p.querySelectorAll('.jb-verification-qr').forEach(function(x){x.remove()});
    var url=(window.getMainWebAppUrl?window.getMainWebAppUrl():window.location.href).split('#')[0];
    url+= (url.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+'verify=1&doc='+encodeURIComponent(key)+'&id='+encodeURIComponent(id);
    var holder=document.createElement('div');
    holder.className='jb-verification-qr';
    holder.style.cssText='text-align:center;margin:12px auto;padding:8px;border:1px dashed #777;width:max-content;background:#fff';
    holder.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px">QR যাচাই</div><div class="jb-qr-box"></div><small>Document ID: '+String(id).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]})+'</small>';
    p.appendChild(holder);
    var box=holder.querySelector('.jb-qr-box');
    try{
      if(window.QRCode){
        new QRCode(box,{text:url,width:110,height:110});
      }else{
        box.innerHTML='<img alt="QR" style="width:110px;height:110px" src="https://quickchart.io/qr?size=220&margin=2&text='+encodeURIComponent(url)+'">';
      }
    }catch(e){
      box.innerHTML='<img alt="QR" style="width:110px;height:110px" src="https://quickchart.io/qr?size=220&margin=2&text='+encodeURIComponent(url)+'">';
    }
  }
  window.jbRenderSavedVerificationQR2026=renderSavedQR;
  var oldSave=window.jbSaveDraft;
  if(typeof oldSave==='function'){
    window.jbSaveDraft=function(){
      return Promise.resolve(oldSave.apply(this,arguments)).then(function(r){
        if(r&&r.ok&&r.documentId){
          var key=(typeof window.jbDocCurrentKey==='function'?window.jbDocCurrentKey():'marks');
          renderSavedQR(key,String(r.documentId));
        }
        return r;
      });
    };
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ===== CENTRAL DOCUMENT BUILDER — QR WHITE PAGE FIX — 2026-10-06 ===== -->
<script id="central-document-builder-qr-white-page-fix-2026-10-06">
(function(){
  function appUrl(){
    var u=String(window.location.href||'').split('#')[0];
    return u;
  }

  function canonicalWebAppUrl_(u){
    u=String(u||'').trim().split('#')[0];

    // Never put the temporary googleusercontent userCodeAppPanel URL in a QR.
    if(/userCodeAppPanel/i.test(u)) return '';

    // Accept only the Apps Script web-app /exec URL.
    if(/https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/s\/[^/]+\/exec/i.test(u)){
      return u;
    }

    return '';
  }

  function verifyUrl(key,id,base){
    base=canonicalWebAppUrl_(base);

    if(!base){
      base=canonicalWebAppUrl_(appUrl());
    }

    if(!base){
      // Last-resort: keep the current host but remove the temporary panel path.
      var origin=String(window.location.origin||'');
      if(/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com$/i.test(origin)){
        base=origin;
      }
    }

    if(!base) return '';

    return base+(base.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+
      'verify=1&doc='+encodeURIComponent(String(key||'marks'))+
      '&id='+encodeURIComponent(String(id||''));
  }

  function safeQR(key,id){
    var p=document.getElementById('jbDocPreview');
    if(!p||!id)return;

    p.querySelectorAll('.jb-verification-qr').forEach(function(x){
      x.remove();
    });

    var holder=document.createElement('div');
    holder.className='jb-verification-qr';
    holder.style.cssText='text-align:center;margin:12px auto;padding:8px;border:1px dashed #777;width:max-content;background:#fff';
    holder.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px">QR যাচাই</div><div class="jb-qr-box"></div><small>Document ID: '+String(id).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]})+'</small>';
    p.appendChild(holder);

    var box=holder.querySelector('.jb-qr-box');

    function renderQR(base){
      var url=verifyUrl(key,id,base);

      // Do not generate a QR at all if a canonical /exec URL cannot be obtained.
      // This prevents another broken white-page QR from being saved.
      if(!url){
        box.innerHTML='<div style="color:#b00;font-weight:700;padding:8px">QR URL পাওয়া যায়নি</div>';
        return;
      }

      try{
        if(window.QRCode){
          new QRCode(box,{text:url,width:110,height:110});
        }else{
          box.innerHTML='<img alt="QR" style="width:110px;height:110px" src="https://quickchart.io/qr?size=220&margin=2&text='+encodeURIComponent(url)+'">';
        }
      }catch(e){
        box.innerHTML='<img alt="QR" style="width:110px;height:110px" src="https://quickchart.io/qr?size=220&margin=2&text='+encodeURIComponent(url)+'">';
      }
    }

    try{
      if(window.google&&google.script&&google.script.run&&google.script.run.getMainWebAppUrl){
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(u){
            var canonical=canonicalWebAppUrl_(u);
            if(canonical){
              renderQR(canonical);
            }else{
              renderQR('');
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(){
            renderQR('');
          })
          .getMainWebAppUrl();
      }else{
        renderQR('');
      }
    }catch(e){
      renderQR('');
    }
  }
    window.jbAddVerificationQR=safeQR;
  window.jbRenderSavedVerificationQR2026=function(key,id){safeQR(key,id)};
  var oldShow=window.jbShowPublicVerification2026;
  if(typeof oldShow==='function'){
    window.jbShowPublicVerification2026=function(key,id,r){
      oldShow.apply(this,arguments);
      var card=document.getElementById('jbPublicVerifyCard');
      if(!card)return;
      var base=appUrl();
      var url=base+(base.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+
        'verify=1&doc='+encodeURIComponent(String(key||'marks'))+
        '&id='+encodeURIComponent(String(id||''));
      var old=card.querySelector('.jb-whitepage-link-tools');
      if(old)old.remove();
      var tools=document.createElement('div');
      tools.className='jb-whitepage-link-tools';
      tools.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px';
      var copy=document.createElement('button');
      copy.className='secondary';
      copy.textContent='🔗 যাচাই লিংক কপি';
      copy.onclick=function(){
        if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function(){copy.textContent='✅ লিংক কপি হয়েছে';});
        }else{
          var t=document.createElement('textarea');t.value=url;document.body.appendChild(t);t.select();
          try{document.execCommand('copy');copy.textContent='✅ লিংক কপি হয়েছে';}catch(e){}
          t.remove();
        }
      };
      tools.appendChild(copy);
      card.appendChild(tools);
    };
  }
})();
</script>
<!-- ===== END QR WHITE PAGE FIX ===== -->

<script id="marksheet-window-controls-2026-10-07-js">
(function(){
  var state={x:null,y:null,full:false,min:false,drag:false,sx:0,sy:0,ox:0,oy:0};
  function get(){return document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderWin')}
  function controls(w){
    if(!w||document.getElementById('jbDocWindowControls2026'))return;
    var head=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderHead');if(!head)return;
    var close=head.querySelector('button');
    var box=document.createElement('div');box.id='jbDocWindowControls2026';box.className='jb-win-controls-2026';
    var min=document.createElement('button');min.type='button';min.className='jb-win-control-2026';min.title='মিনিমাইজ';min.textContent='—';
    var full=document.createElement('button');full.type='button';full.className='jb-win-control-2026';full.title='ফুল স্ক্রিন';full.textContent='⛶';
    box.appendChild(min);box.appendChild(full);
    if(close){head.insertBefore(box,close);close.title='বন্ধ'}else head.appendChild(box);
    min.onclick=function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();toggleMin(w)};
    full.onclick=function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();toggleFull(w)};
  }
  function savePos(w){
    var r=w.getBoundingClientRect();state.x=r.left;state.y=r.top;
  }
  function clamp(w,x,y){
    var maxX=Math.max(0,window.innerWidth-w.offsetWidth),maxY=Math.max(0,window.innerHeight-w.offsetHeight);
    return {x:Math.min(Math.max(0,x),maxX),y:Math.min(Math.max(0,y),maxY)};
  }
  function restorePosition(w){
    if(state.x==null||state.y==null)return;
    w.style.left=state.x+'px';w.style.top=state.y+'px';w.style.right='auto';w.style.bottom='auto';w.style.inset='auto';w.style.transform='none';
    var p=clamp(w,state.x,state.y);w.style.left=p.x+'px';w.style.top=p.y+'px';state.x=p.x;state.y=p.y;
  }
  function toggleMin(w){
    if(state.min){state.min=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-min');if(state.full){w.classList.add('jb-window-full')}else restorePosition(w);return;}
    if(state.full){state.full=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-full')}
    savePos(w);state.min=true;w.classList.add('jb-window-min');
  }
  function toggleFull(w){
    if(state.min){state.min=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-min')}
    state.full=!state.full;
    w.classList.toggle('jb-window-full',state.full);
    if(!state.full)restorePosition(w);
  }
  function bindDrag(w){
    if(w.dataset.jbDragBound==='1')return;w.dataset.jbDragBound='1';
    var head=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderHead');if(!head)return;
    head.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
      if(e.button!==0)return;
      if(e.target.closest('button,input,select,textarea,a'))return;
      if(state.min){state.min=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-min');state.full=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-full')}
      if(state.full)return;
      var r=w.getBoundingClientRect();state.drag=true;state.sx=e.clientX;state.sy=e.clientY;state.ox=r.left;state.oy=r.top;
      w.classList.add('jb-window-dragging');w.setPointerCapture&&w.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);e.preventDefault();
    });
    head.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
      if(!state.drag)return;
      var p=clamp(w,state.ox+(e.clientX-state.sx),state.oy+(e.clientY-state.sy));
      w.style.left=p.x+'px';w.style.top=p.y+'px';w.style.right='auto';w.style.bottom='auto';w.style.inset='auto';w.style.transform='none';state.x=p.x;state.y=p.y;
    });
    function up(){state.drag=false;w.classList.remove('jb-window-dragging')}
    head.addEventListener('pointerup',up);head.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
  }
  function ensure(){var w=get();if(!w)return;controls(w);bindDrag(w)}
  var oldOpen=window.jbOpenDocumentType2026;
  if(typeof oldOpen==='function')window.jbOpenDocumentType2026=function(){var r=oldOpen.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(ensure,30);return r};
  var oldModule=window.openModule;
  if(typeof oldModule==='function')window.openModule=function(k){var r=oldModule.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(ensure,30);return r};
  var oldCreate=window.jbCreatePreview;
  if(typeof oldCreate==='function')window.jbCreatePreview=function(){var r=oldCreate.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(ensure,30);return r};
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){var w=get();if(!w||!w.classList.contains('show')||state.full)return;if(state.min)return;var p=clamp(w,state.x==null?w.getBoundingClientRect().left:state.x,state.y==null?w.getBoundingClientRect().top:state.y);w.style.left=p.x+'px';w.style.top=p.y+'px';w.style.right='auto';w.style.bottom='auto';w.style.inset='auto';w.style.transform='none';state.x=p.x;state.y=p.y});
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',ensure);else ensure();
})();
</script>

(function(){

  }

  }

      if(n.dataset&&n.dataset.jbKeepInstitution==='1')return;

      if((t===NAME||t===ADDRESS)&&n.parentNode){
        n.remove();
      }
    });
  }
  function addHeader(p){

    p.dataset.jbContactHeader2026='1';

    /* Reuse the exact contact panel from below the login page. */

<script id="document-builder-non-marks-card-preview-fix-2026-10-07">
(function(){

  if(typeof oldCreate!=='function')return;

  function key(){
    var t=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderTitle')?.textContent||'';
    return t.indexOf('ফলাফল')>=0?'result':
      t.indexOf('মার্কশিট')>=0?'marks':
      t.indexOf('আইডি কার্ড')>=0?'id_cards':
      t.indexOf('অ্যাডমিট কার্ড')>=0?'admit_cards':

  }
  function e(v){
    return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
  }
  function v(k){
    var x=document.querySelector('#jbDocFields [data-key="'+k+'"]');
    return x?String(x.value||'').trim():'';
  }
  function checked(k){
    var x=document.querySelector('#jbDocFields [data-key="'+k+'"]');
    var box=x&&x.parentElement?x.parentElement.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]'):null;
    return !box||box.checked;
  }
  function title(k){
    return k==='id_cards'?'আইডি কার্ড':
      k==='admit_cards'?'অ্যাডমিট কার্ড':

(function(){
  function addBack(){
    var title=document.getElementById('jbDocBuilderTitle');
    if(!title)return;
    var t=title.textContent||'';
    if(t.indexOf('মার্কশিট')<0 && t.indexOf('ফলাফল')<0)return;

    if(!wrap)return;

    if(p.querySelector('.jb-marksheet-back-2026'))return;
    var b=document.createElement('button');

    b.textContent='↩️';b.title='পূর্বে ফিরে যান';b.setAttribute('aria-label','পূর্বে ফিরে যান');

      if(body)body.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
      var id=document.getElementById('jbDocId');
      if(id)setTimeout(function(){id.focus()},250);
    };
    var bar=p.querySelector('.jb-doc-actions');
    if(bar)bar.appendChild(b);else p.appendChild(b);
  }
  var old=window.jbCreatePreview;
  if(typeof old==='function'){
    window.jbCreatePreview=function(){
      var r=old.apply(this,arguments);

      return r;
    };
  }

    if(e.target && e.target.id==='jbDocBuilderTitle')return;

  });
})();

<script id="jb-online-service-public-search-2026-10-07">
(function(){
  var CODES={MS:1,RS:1,ID:1,AC:1,CT:1,RC:1,TI:1,AF:1,LF:1,ER:1,TC:1,AP:1,LM:1,LC:1,TR:1,TA:1,EF:1,EI:1};
  function E(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
  function openOnline(sig,q){
    /* Always resolve the real Apps Script Web App URL before navigating; show a status instead of a blank tab. */
    var target=window.open('about:blank','_blank');
    if(!target){
      if(typeof toast==='function')toast('অনলাইন সেবা খুলতে ব্রাউজারের Popup অনুমতি দিন।');
      else alert('অনলাইন সেবা খুলতে ব্রাউজারের Popup অনুমতি দিন।');
      return;
    }
    try{
      target.document.open();
      target.document.write('<!doctype html><html lang="bn"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>অনলাইন সেবা</title><body style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:32px;text-align:center;color:#174b42"><h2>জান্নাতুল বাক্বী — অনলাইন সেবা</h2><p id="msg">সঠিক সেবা ঠিকানা খোঁজা হচ্ছে, অনুগ্রহ করে অপেক্ষা করুন…</p></body></html>');
      target.document.close();
    }catch(e){}
    function fail(message){
      try{
        var p=target.document.getElementById('msg');
        if(p)p.textContent=message;
      }catch(e){}
    }
    try{
      if(typeof google!=='undefined'&&google.script&&google.script.run){
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(r){
            var base=String(r&&r.ok&&r.url?r.url:'').trim().split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
            if(!base){fail('সেবা ঠিকানা পাওয়া যায়নি। Code.gs-এর getMainWebAppUrl এবং Web App deployment যাচাই করুন।');return;}
            target.location.replace(base+'?online=1&code='+encodeURIComponent(sig)+'&id='+encodeURIComponent(q));
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(e){
            fail('সার্ভার থেকে সেবা ঠিকানা পাওয়া যায়নি। Code.gs-এ getMainWebAppUrl এবং সর্বশেষ Web App deployment যাচাই করুন।');
          })
          .getMainWebAppUrl();
      }else{
        fail('এই পেজটি Google Apps Script Web App থেকে খুলুন; সরাসরি ফাইল/প্রিভিউ থেকে অনলাইন সেবা সার্চ করা যাবে না।');
      }
    }catch(e){
      fail('অনলাইন সেবা খুলতে সমস্যা হয়েছে: '+String(e&&e.message||e));
    }
  }
  var old=window.doSearch;
  if(typeof old!=='function')return;
  window.doSearch=function(where){
    var se=E(where==='login'?'loginSignal':'appSignal');
    var inp=E(where==='login'?'loginSearch':'appSearch');
    var sig=String(se&&se.value||'').trim().toUpperCase();
    var q=String(inp&&inp.value||'').trim();
    if(CODES[sig]){
      if(!q)return toast('সংকেত নির্বাচন করে ID দিন।');
      openOnline(sig,q);
      return;
    }
    return old.apply(this,arguments);
  };
})();

<!-- ===== UNIVERSAL ID SEARCH ENTER BINDING — 2026-10-09 ===== -->
<script id="universal-id-search-enter-binding-2026-10-09">
(function(){
  function bindOne(id,where){
    var el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el || el.dataset.universalEnterBound==='1') return;
    el.dataset.universalEnterBound='1';
    el.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='Enter'){
        ev.preventDefault();
        if(typeof window.doSearch==='function') window.doSearch(where);
      }
    });
  }
  function bind(){
    bindOne('loginSearch','login'); bindOne('appSearch','app');
    bindOne('loginSignal','login'); bindOne('appSignal','app');
    var l=document.getElementById('loginSearch'), a=document.getElementById('appSearch');
    if(l)l.placeholder='একই ID লিখুন—সংকেত বদলে Enter চাপুন';
    if(a)a.placeholder='একই ID লিখুন—সংকেত বদলে Enter চাপুন';
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',bind);
  else bind();
  setTimeout(bind,300);setTimeout(bind,1000);
})();
</script>

    /* Keep the one entered ID unchanged when only the signal/type changes. */
    var code=sig?String(sig.value||'').trim():'';
    q.placeholder=code?code+' — একই ID দিয়ে Enter চাপুন':'সংকেত নির্বাচন করে একই ID লিখুন';
  };
  function bind(){
    ['login','app'].forEach(function(where){
      var sig=getSignal(where),q=getQuery(where);
      if(sig&&!sig.dataset.unifiedIdSearchBound){
        sig.dataset.unifiedIdSearchBound='1';
        sig.addEventListener('change',function(){window.syncSearchSignal(where);});
      }
      if(q&&!q.dataset.unifiedIdSearchBound){
        q.dataset.unifiedIdSearchBound='1';
        q.dataset.oldPlaceholder=q.placeholder||'';
        q.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
          if(ev.key==='Enter'){
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            if(typeof window.doSearch==='function')window.doSearch(where);
          }
        },true);
      }
      window.syncSearchSignal(where);
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',bind);
  else bind();
  setTimeout(bind,300);
  setTimeout(bind,1000);
})();
</script>

  function syncAdmissionFeeDropdown2026(){
    var keys=['AdmissionFee','RegistrationFee','MonthlySalary','ResidentialFee','MonthlyFoodFee','SessionFee'];
    var sel=E('admFeeCategories2026');
    keys.forEach(function(k){
      var cb=E('admFeeCheck_'+k),opt=sel&&Array.from(sel.options).find(function(o){return o.value===k});
      if(opt)opt.selected=!!(cb&&cb.checked);
      var lab=E('admFeeAmountWrap_'+k);if(lab)lab.style.display=cb&&cb.checked?'block':'none';
    });
  }

    if(!validateRequiredAdmissionFields2026())return null;
    if(savedAdmission)return savedAdmission;

    savedAdmission={admissionId:(r.row&&r.row.AdmissionID)||d.FormID,studentId:sid,data:d};
    try{var pdfHtml=window.jbArchivePdfHtml2026('admission_form',d);var pdfSaved=await call('saveAdmissionPdfArchive2026',token,'admission_form',d.FormID||d.HandwrittenID,d,pdfHtml);if(!pdfSaved||!pdfSaved.ok){if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('ভর্তি সেভ হয়েছে, তবে PDF আর্কাইভে সংরক্ষণ হয়নি: '+((pdfSaved&&pdfSaved.message)||'ত্রুটি'));}else if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('ভর্তি ফর্মের PDF অল ডকুমেন্টসে সংরক্ষিত হয়েছে।');}catch(pdfErr){if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast('ভর্তি সেভ হয়েছে, কিন্তু PDF সংরক্ষণে সমস্যা: '+(pdfErr&&pdfErr.message||pdfErr));}

  function dateValue(row,keys){
    var candidates=keys.filter(function(k){return /date|তারিখ|created|সময়/i.test(String(k))});
    for(var i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){var v=row[candidates[i]];if(v==null||v==='')continue;var s=String(v);var m=s.match(/(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})/);if(m)return m[1]+'-'+('0'+m[2]).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+m[3]).slice(-2);var d=new Date(v);if(!isNaN(d.getTime()))return d.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+d.getDate()).slice(-2)}
    return '';
  }

  window.jbLoadAllReports20261011=async function(){

    try{
      for(var i=0;i<names.length;i++){
        var sheet=names[i];
        try{
          var response=await call('getSheetData',token,sheet,5000);
          if(!response||!response.ok)throw new Error(response&&response.message?response.message:'শিটের তথ্য পাওয়া যায়নি');
          var rows=rowsOf(response),headers=Array.isArray(response.headers)?response.headers.slice():Object.keys(rows[0]||{});
          if(!headers.length&&rows.length)headers=Object.keys(rows[0]);
          var filtered=rows.filter(function(row){
            var dt=dateValue(row,headers);
            if(from&&(!dt||dt<from))return false;
            if(to&&(!dt||dt>to))return false;
            if(q&&JSON.stringify(row).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return false;
            return true;
          });
          reports.push({sheet:sheet,label:(SHEETS.find(function(x){return x.value===sheet})||{}).label||sheet,headers:headers,rows:filtered,total:rows.length});
        }catch(e){errors.push(sheet+': '+String(e&&e.message||e))}
      }
      var count=reports.reduce(function(n,r){return n+r.rows.length},0);
      summary.innerHTML='<div class="form-grid"><div class="card" style="padding:10px"><b>রিপোর্ট বিভাগ</b><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900">'+reports.length+'</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:10px"><b>মোট রেকর্ড</b><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900">'+count+'</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:10px"><b>তারিখ/সার্চের আগে রেকর্ড</b><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900">'+reports.reduce(function(n,r){return n+r.total},0)+'</div></div></div>';
      if(!reports.length){status.textContent='রিপোর্ট পাওয়া যায়নি। '+errors.join(' | ');return}
      out.innerHTML=reports.map(function(rep){
        var heads=rep.headers.length?rep.headers:Object.keys(rep.rows[0]||{});
        return '<section class="card jb-report-section-20261011" data-sheet="'+esc(rep.sheet)+'" style="padding:10px;margin:12px 0"><h3>'+esc(rep.label)+' ('+rep.rows.length+')</h3><div class="jb-report-table-wrap">'+
          (rep.rows.length&&heads.length?'<table><thead><tr>'+heads.map(function(h){return '<th>'+esc(h)+'</th>'}).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+rep.rows.map(function(row){return '<tr>'+heads.map(function(h){return '<td>'+esc(row[h])+'</td>'}).join('')+'</tr>'}).join('')+'</tbody></table>':'<p>এই বিভাগে নির্বাচিত শর্তে কোনো রেকর্ড নেই।</p>')+'</div></section>';
      }).join('');
      status.textContent='✓ রিপোর্ট তৈরি হয়েছে।'+(errors.length?' কিছু শিট পাওয়া যায়নি/অ্যাক্সেস নেই: '+errors.join(' | '):' সব নির্বাচিত শিট লোড হয়েছে।')+' (সার্ভারের ফেরত দেওয়া রেকর্ডের সীমা প্রযোজ্য।';

  };
